metadata.description: Skills for the 13 ArtCraft apps (storytold): operating manuals plus a built-in MCP server setup guide for Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: effectcraft
plugins.description: Create and edit motion graphics and compositions with EffectCraft (After Effects-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: filmcraft
plugins.description: Edit video projects with FilmCraft (Premiere Pro-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: photocraft
plugins.description: Edit raster images and layered documents with PhotoCraft (Photoshop-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: vectorcraft
plugins.description: Create and edit vector graphics with VectorCraft (Illustrator-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: lightcraft
plugins.description: Manage photo libraries and develop RAW photos with LightCraft (Lightroom-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: designcraft
plugins.description: Lay out pages and publications with DesignCraft (InDesign-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: pdfcraft
plugins.description: Read, edit, fill, redact, sign and export PDFs with PdfCraft (Acrobat-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: cadcraft
plugins.description: Draw, edit, inspect and export DXF/DWG drawings with CADCraft (AutoCAD-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: deckcraft
plugins.description: Create and edit presentations (.pptx) with DeckCraft (PowerPoint-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: figcraft
plugins.description: Design interfaces, components and prototypes with FigCraft (Figma-style, ArtCraft suite, not the official Figma tools) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: gridcraft
plugins.description: Read, create, format and export spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv) with GridCraft (Excel-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: soundcraft
plugins.description: Record, edit, mix and bounce audio sessions with SoundCraft (Pro Tools-style DAW, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.

plugins.name: wordcraft
plugins.description: Write, format, review and export documents (.docx, PDF) with WordCraft (Word-style, ArtCraft suite) through MCP, the CLI or the control channel, and set up, connect or troubleshoot its MCP server on Windows and macOS.
